Method of Attack: Malware loader (dropper) that infects victims, gains persistence, reports to C&C server, downloads second-stage payloads such as banking trojans, password-dumpers, backdoor trojans, or ransomware
Includes botshop feature allowing buyers to sell access to bots

Features advertised include bot functionality, download and execute task, update task, uninstall task, usermode rootkit (not yet implemented), RC4 encryption (not yet implemented), debug and analysis protection, TOR support (not found in analyzed samples), domain generation algorithm (DGA)
Discoverer: TJ Nelson (Security Research Analyst for Arbor)
Impacted Systems: User computers infected by the loader, forming botnets
Attack Vector: Malware loader infection chains, sold on hacking forums, buyers use loader to infect users with second-stage malware
Indicators of Compromise: One botshop panel found via Google search
Screenshot showing 124 infections in loader’s test network
